sourceTree: Measured from the implementation tree committed as 61528a48a6a5271576e5bf3fd8b4a3caf0a55f21; this report is the only later evidence file.
sampleMethod: One generated release-build sample per case with a single Cargo build job because another checkout was compiling concurrently. Per-case totalMs excludes Rust compilation; commandElapsedMs includes it. workingSetDeltaBytes is the Windows process working-set sample after the completed operation minus the sample immediately before stage_crop, so it is process-memory evidence rather than a peak claim.
persistenceTimingScope: databaseMs spans the Phase 1 register_staged creating-row insert, destination-root staging promotion into Newspaper snapshots/<edition>/, canonical validation, and ready-state update.
concurrencyEvidence: The generated samples are uncontended (queueWaitMs is 0). The deterministic barrier test clipping_crop_serializes_distinct_requests_with_one_active_crop_section proves the one-lane bound, and the structural gate requires the crop permit plus admission and source-recheck ordering.
uiStallEvidence: The command adapter dispatches native crop work through Tauri spawn_blocking. The separate Reader browser matrix proves responsive selection and one-shot save behavior while the newspaper performance gates cover 8, 50, and 500-page libraries.
